caption_L1: Here a area chart is called Birth rate in Italy from 2002 to 2019 (per 1,000 inhabitants). The y-axis plots Birth rate per thousand inhabitants while the x-axis shows Year.
caption_L2L3: The birth rate starts off at about 9 per 1,000 inhabitants and holds fairly steady at this rate until 2010. Subsequent to 2010, there is a notable drop in the birthrate. The lowest birthrate recorded is for 2019, by which point it has dropped to 7 per 1,000 inhabitants.
